description.summary: frame-perfect window management in a spatial compositor

protocol.description:
This protocol allows a single window manager client to determine the window management policy of a spatial compositor: which place a window belongs to, its pose within the place, its proposed dimensions, its visibility, and how the members of a place are arranged. State is globally double-buffered so that changes involving several windows land in one frame.
The compositor keeps the invariants a window manager may not override: the existence and poses of reference frames, the comfort limits every pose is clamped to, the focus rules, the boundary, the perception layers, hit-testing and composition. Requests that would violate a limit are clamped, not rejected, and the applied state is reported.
Places and frames are those of ext_workspace_v1 and zxr_workspace_v1: a workspace is a place, a workspace group is a frame. This protocol adds no place lifecycle of its own.
The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall", "shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may", and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as described in IETF RFC 2119.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the experimental phase. Backward incompatible changes may be added without bumping the major version of the extension. As such, gating usage on the protocol's presence is discouraged outside Mura itself.

interface.name: zxr_window_manager_v1
interface.description:
This global interface should only be advertised to the window manager process. Only one window management client may be active at a time; the compositor uses the unavailable event to enforce this.
Two disjoint categories of state are managed by this protocol.
Management state influences the communication between the compositor and individual windows: place assignment, proposed dimensions, maximized and fullscreen state, and focus hints. Management state may only be modified as part of a manage sequence, started by the manage_start event and ended by the manage_finish request.
Rendering state affects only what the compositor presents: poses, visibility, flags, a place's engine and arrangement. Rendering state may be modified during a manage sequence or a render sequence and is applied by the next render_finish request.
A manage sequence is always followed by at least one render sequence. The compositor starts a manage sequence by sending the changed state followed by manage_start whenever state must be communicated to the window manager, and a render sequence by sending new dimensions followed by render_start whenever a window's dimensions change.
It is a protocol error to modify management state outside a manage sequence, to modify rendering state outside a manage or render sequence, or to send manage_finish or render_finish out of order; such requests raise the sequence_order error.
The behaviour of the compositor when the window manager client disconnects is compositor policy.

entry.name: sequence_order
entry.summary: request violates the manage/render sequence ordering

entry.name: unresponsive
entry.summary: window manager did not finish a sequence in time

entry.name: invalid_pose
entry.summary: pose matrix is not a rigid transform or has the wrong length

entry.name: invalid_dimensions
entry.summary: proposed dimensions are negative

enum.name: capability
enum.description: Optional capabilities of the compositor. Requests that require an absent capability are ignored; clients should hide or disable the UI elements that depend on them.

entry.name: focus_hint
entry.summary: zxr_managed_window_v1.focus_hint is honored

entry.name: hide
entry.summary: zxr_managed_window_v1.hide and show are honored

entry.name: engine
entry.summary: zxr_managed_place_v1.set_engine and arrange are honored

entry.name: emphasis
entry.summary: zxr_managed_place_v1.set_emphasis is honored

entry.name: exclusive
entry.summary: zxr_managed_window_v1.grant_exclusive is honored

event.name: unavailable
event.description: This event indicates that window management is not available to the client, for example because another window management client is already active. If sent, this event is the first and only event sent on this object. The client should destroy this object.

event.name: capabilities
event.description: This event advertises the compositor's optional capabilities. It is sent once, before the first manage_start event.

event.name: limits
event.description:
This event states the limits every window pose is clamped to. A set_pose request whose result would place a window closer than min_distance or farther than max_distance from the wearer, or make its apparent width exceed max_angular_size, is clamped to the limit and the clamped pose is reported in zxr_managed_window_v1.state.
Distances are in metres, angles in degrees. This event is sent once before the first manage_start event and again whenever the limits change.

request.name: stop
request.description: This request indicates that the client no longer wishes to receive events on this object. The compositor will send a finished event after which no further events are sent.

event.name: finished

description.summary: the compositor is done with the window manager

event.description: This event is sent after the stop request; no further events will be sent on this object or on objects created through it. The client should destroy the object.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the zxr_window_manager_v1 object. Objects created through this interface become inert.

event.name: manage_start
event.description: This event starts a manage sequence. All events describing changed management state since the previous sequence have been sent before it. The client may now modify management and rendering state and must end the sequence with manage_finish carrying the same serial.

request.name: manage_finish
request.description: Finish the manage sequence identified by serial. The compositor applies the management state and sends the new state to the affected windows. Sending this request outside a manage sequence or with a serial other than the current one raises the sequence_order error.

request.name: manage_dirty

description.summary: ensure a manage sequence is started

request.description: Ask the compositor to start a manage sequence as soon as possible because the window manager's own state changed. The compositor must send manage_start after this request, possibly after finishing an in-flight render sequence.

event.name: render_start
event.description: This event starts a render sequence. All dimensions events since the previous sequence have been sent before it. The client may now modify rendering state and must end the sequence with render_finish carrying the same serial.

request.name: render_finish
request.description: Finish the render sequence identified by serial. All rendering state modified since the start of the enclosing manage sequence is applied atomically. Sending this request outside a render sequence or with a serial other than the current one raises the sequence_order error.

event.name: window
event.description: This event announces a toplevel window that has requested to be mapped. The window is not presented until the window manager has assigned it to a place, the compositor has sent its first dimensions event, and a render sequence has finished.

request.name: get_place

description.summary: obtain the management extension of a place

request.description: Create a zxr_managed_place_v1 object for an ext_workspace_handle_v1. A place has at most one such object; creating a second raises the already_managed error on the new object's interface.

interface.name: zxr_managed_window_v1
interface.description:
A toplevel window under the window manager's policy. Events describe the window's identity, hints and the requests its client makes; requests set the window's place, pose, dimensions and visibility.
Dimensions are in the compositor's logical coordinate space and refer to the window content. Poses are 4x4 column-major matrices of binary32 values in native endianness, rigid transforms from the window's local space to its place's local space; the window's local origin is the centre of its content plane and its local +z points toward the viewer.

entry.name: plane
entry.summary: a 2D toplevel presented as a plane

entry.name: volume
entry.summary: a 3D client presented as a volume

entry.name: angular
entry.summary: apparent size is held constant across distance

entry.name: physical
entry.summary: metric size is held constant across distance

enum.name: flags
enum.description: Flags that tell the compositor how the wearer and the place's engine may treat the window. A window is not draggable unless the draggable flag is set; it is not moved by arrangement unless the managed flag is set; it is excluded from arrangement and recenter if pinned.

entry.name: draggable
entry.summary: the wearer may move it

entry.name: managed
entry.summary: the place's engine may move it

entry.name: hoverable
entry.summary: it receives hover

entry.name: pinned
entry.summary: excluded from arrangement and recenter

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the zxr_managed_window_v1 object. The window itself is not affected.

event.name: kind
event.description: Sent once before the first manage_start that includes this window.

event.name: parent
event.description: The window is a transient of parent. A transient window is placed by the compositor relative to its parent and follows it; assign and set_pose requests on a transient window are ignored. A null parent means the window is a toplevel in its own right.

event.name: dimensions_hint
event.description: The minimum and maximum content dimensions the client accepts. A value of zero means no constraint in that dimension.

event.name: dimensions
event.description: The dimensions of the window content. The width and height are strictly greater than zero. This event is sent as part of a render sequence before the render_start event, because of a propose_dimensions request in a previous manage sequence or because the window independently changed its dimensions.

event.name: state
event.description: The place and pose the compositor applied after clamping to its limits, and the applied scale mode. A null place means the window is not yet assigned and is not presented. This event is sent as part of a manage sequence before manage_start whenever the applied state differs from the last reported one.

event.name: move_requested

description.summary: the client requested an interactive move

event.description: The window's client requested an interactive move with the given serial. The window manager may start a move through the seat or ignore the request.

description.summary: the client requested an interactive resize
the client requested to be maximized
the client requested to be unmaximized
the client requested to leave fullscreen

event.name: minimize_requested

description.summary: the client requested to be minimized

event.description: The compositor defines no minimized state; what the request means is window management policy.

event.name: exclusive_requested
event.description: The window's client requested that its scene take the environment layer. Sent only if the compositor advertised the exclusive capability.

event.name: closed
event.description: The compositor will immediately consider the object inert. Any requests will be ignored except the destroy request. There won't be any more events referencing this object.

request.name: close

description.summary: ask the client to close the window

request.description: Ask the window's client to close the window. There is no guarantee that the window will actually be closed.

request.name: assign

description.summary: assign the window to a place

request.description:
Make the window a member of place. A window is a member of at most one place; assigning it to another removes it from the previous one. A null place unassigns the window, which is then not presented.
This request modifies management state and may only be made as part of a manage sequence.

request.name: set_pose

description.summary: set the window's pose within its place

request.description:
Set the transform from the window's local space to its place's local space. The array must hold exactly 16 binary32 values, column-major, native endianness, forming a rigid transform (rotation and translation only); otherwise the invalid_pose error is raised. The compositor clamps the pose to the limits stated by zxr_window_manager_v1.limits and reports the applied pose in state.
This request modifies rendering state and may be made as part of a manage or render sequence.

request.name: propose_dimensions
request.description:
Propose content dimensions for the window. Width and height must be greater than or equal to zero; a zero value lets the window decide that dimension. Negative values raise the invalid_dimensions error. The window may not take the exact dimensions proposed; the actual dimensions are sent in a subsequent dimensions event.
This request modifies management state and may only be made as part of a manage sequence.

request.name: set_scale_mode

description.summary: set how the window scales with distance

request.description: This request modifies rendering state.

request.name: set_flags
request.description: This request modifies rendering state.

request.name: hide
request.description: Stop presenting the window while keeping its place and pose. A hidden window receives no frame callbacks. Ignored unless the hide capability is advertised. This request modifies rendering state.

request.name: show
request.description: Present a window previously hidden with hide. This request modifies rendering state.

request.name: set_maximized
request.description:
Set or clear the maximized state communicated to the window's client. The dimensions a maximized window takes are those the window manager proposes; the compositor only informs the client.
This request modifies management state.

request.name: set_fullscreen
request.description:
Set or clear the fullscreen state communicated to the window's client. While fullscreen, the compositor sizes the window to fill its place's presentation band and ignores set_pose and propose_dimensions for it.
This request modifies management state.

request.name: focus_hint

description.summary: suggest keyboard focus for this window

request.description: Suggest that this window receive keyboard focus. The compositor's focus rules decide whether the hint is honored; there is no guarantee that focus changes. Ignored unless the focus_hint capability is advertised. This request modifies management state.

request.name: grant_exclusive
request.description:
Grant the window's client exclusive presentation of the environment layer, or revoke it. At most one window may hold the grant; granting a second revokes the first. The compositor's own layers remain presented and the wearer's recenter gesture ends the grant. Ignored unless the exclusive capability is advertised.
This request modifies management state.

interface.name: zxr_managed_place_v1

description.summary: the management extension of a place

interface.description: Window-management state of one place: the engine that arranges its members and the emphasis of one member. Membership is conveyed by member_enter and member_leave events; a done event closes each batch of membership changes.

entry.name: already_managed
entry.summary: the place already has a management object

entry.name: free
entry.summary: members keep the poses they were given

entry.name: arc
entry.summary: members occupy slots on an arc around the wearer

entry.name: dock
entry.summary: members occupy slots on a bar facing the wearer

entry.name: band
entry.summary: members tile into one curved band

entry.name: custom
entry.summary: the window manager arranges members itself

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the zxr_managed_place_v1 object. The place and its members are not affected.

event.name: engine
event.description: Sent once before the first manage_start that includes this place and whenever the engine changes.

description.summary: a window became a member of the place
a window ceased to be a member of the place

event.name: done

description.summary: all information about the place has been sent

event.description: This event is sent after all changes to the place's state have been sent. This allows changes to the place's membership and engine to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.

event.name: removed
event.description: The compositor will immediately consider the object inert. Any requests will be ignored except the destroy request. There won't be any more events referencing this object.

request.name: set_engine
request.description: Set the engine that arranges the place's managed members. With the custom engine the compositor arranges nothing and the window manager sets every member's pose itself. Ignored unless the engine capability is advertised. This request modifies rendering state.

request.name: arrange
request.description: Ask the place's engine to arrange its managed, unpinned members once. The resulting poses are reported in each member's state event. Ignored with the custom engine or unless the engine capability is advertised. This request modifies rendering state.

request.name: set_emphasis

description.summary: emphasize one member of the place

request.description: Present window with emphasis: the compositor dims the environment layer and the other members of the place while window is emphasized. A null window ends the emphasis. Ignored unless the emphasis capability is advertised. This request modifies rendering state.

arg.name: window
arg.summary: the window to emphasize or null
